set.body: Replace every narr.NArray use in ScalaFIM image production and tests with canonical Ravel arrays, private MutableNDArray workspaces, or invariant-bearing semantic types backed by Ravel. Convert NeuroVol, NeuroVec, NeuroSlice, mask, ROI, sparse, clustered, searchlight, validity, filter, statistics, and NIfTI surfaces. Remove NArrayUtil and the Scala.js dynamic extension. No compatibility NArray overload remains. Acceptance: image JVM/JS tests pass; public API scan is clean; scalafim-image POM has no narr dependency; image workload parity/allocation/performance receipts pass. Cross-store Ravel prerequisite: bd-01KYQ9JBJGZPWX0N2XXMSASMEM.
set.title: Remove narr from ScalaFIM image core and public APIs
